summary: Trio-Tech International filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 1,052,632 common shares at $9.50 per share, grossing $10M. The offering is to accredited investors with D. Boral Capital as placement agent on a best-efforts basis, earning a 4.5% fee. Shares trade on NYSE American under TRT; last sale was $16.52 on April 24, 2026—a 42.5% discount. Closing expected April 27, 2026. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review; simply an at-the-market-like placement with a placement agent.
